children: FDCTech announced it has moved its principal executive offices to Limassol, Cyprus to be closer to its operating subsidiaries and regulators.
Relocated principal executive offices effective Sept. 9, 2026 to Ground Floor, 10A Eleftheriou Venizelou Street, Limassol, Cyprus.
Move approved by the Board by unanimous written consent to place senior management nearer principal operating subsidiaries and regulators.
Relocation intended to improve oversight of subsidiaries (including Crestmark Trading Ltd. and Alchemy Prime Limited) and reduce travel time and expenses.
Company remains incorporated in Delaware, retains U.S. reporting obligations, and does not expect the move to materially affect operations or financial condition.
